items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Edward the VIII as an amateur drummer; the interviewee does not respond with any personal connection or interaction.

ctx.x: Yes, I have a lot of -- well, I know everybody in London, and I know so many people throughout the U.K. and I played -- I must have played in the 16 years I have been coming here on and off, I must have played 100 cities, you know, and they are all jazz -- you know, you must
realize the British have been supporting American music, that would be dance music and jazz for some 70 years, and the Prince of Wales, Edward the VIII was an amateur drummer.
Yes, I remember, Prince George too.
